{{Quote|Lord Vader, this is an unexpected pleasure. We're honored by your presence.|Tiaan Jerjerrod greets Vader on behalf of Mianda and the others present|audio=Jerjerrod-Honored-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
'''Mianda''' was a [[human]] who flew as a [[pilot]] for the [[Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], earning the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[major]]. He was part of a group of [[Imperial officer]]s that lined up in a [[hangar]] on the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] for the arrival of [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in [[4 ABY]]. During the [[Battle of Endor]], he flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Fighters coming in!|[[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] spots the Imperial starfighters at the Battle of Endor|audio=Lando-Fighters-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
Mianda<ref name="AMG" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[pilot]] who reached the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[major]] within the [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|officer corps]] of the [[Imperial Navy]]<ref name="AMG" /> during the [[Galactic Empire]]'s fight against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> he<ref name="AMG" /> was part of the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] stationed on board the Imperial [[superweapon]] known as the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]], which was being constructed in the [[Endor system]]. During the construction, Mianda stood in a line of [[Imperial officer]]s within one of the [[Battle station|station's]] [[hangar]]s for the arrival of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in order to increase the speed of its construction. Upon disembarking from his [[ST 321|shuttle]], Vader greeted [[Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod]] and walked with Jerjerrod past Mianda, who remained still.<ref name="ROTJ" /> After Vader exited the hangar, the Moff matched the [[Sith Lord]]'s gait and rhythm in his own departure in the hopes that all those assembled in the hangar, such as Mianda, would see how aligned and attuned the pair were based on the harmony in the choreography of their parting.<ref name="FACPOV">{{StoryCite|story=Any Work Worth Doing|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}</ref>

[[File:MajorMianda-SWZ99.png|thumb|left|300px|Mianda piloted a TIE fighter during the Battle of Endor.]]
[[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] later joined Vader on the [[Death Star]] as part of a trap that the [[Emperor]] was setting for the Alliance, using himself and the station's unfinished nature as bait for the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|rebel fleet]]. Falling for the bait, the rebel [[fleet]] entered the Endor system and [[Battle of Endor|attacked]] the Death Star before being surrounded by Imperial forces. Wanting to demonstrate the power of the Death Star's [[superlaser]] on the larger rebel [[Starship|ships]], Palpatine ordered only the Imperial [[starfighter]]s to engage,<ref name="ROTJ" /> with Mianda flying against the Alliance in a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] and firing upon them while alongside two other [[TIE series|TIEs]].<ref name="AMG" /> After it took down the Death Star's [[Endor shield generator bunker|shields]], the Alliance claimed victory in the battle by destroying the Death Star.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Mianda had [[Color|black]] [[hair]] and light skin.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
Mianda wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with black [[boot]]s, a black [[belt]], and an [[Imperial kepi]] that bore an [[officer's disk]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> He flew a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="AMG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Major_mianda.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mianda was identified on a card in the ''Star Wars'' Legends continuty.]]
Mianda first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The character's scene was filmed on Stage 6 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[February 22]] and [[February 24]], [[1982]]. The movement and positioning of the various extras on the set caused regular damage to the hangar's floor and required it to be repainted several times.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Mianda's name was first used in a preview for the [[2024]] ''[[Battle Over Endor Scenario Pack]]'' set for [[Atomic Mass Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'' board game.<ref name="AMG" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Mianda/Legends|Mianda]] was first identified in Legends in [[2000]] on a card in the "[[Death Star II Limited]]" set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] published by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Major Mianda}}</ref>
